name: Achari Soya Chaap

ingredients.name: plain soya chaap, drained and sliced

steps: Drain packaged soya chaap, rinse briefly and pat dry. Cut into thick diagonal pieces so the achari marinade can coat each surface.
Crush fennel, mustard, fenugreek and nigella coarsely. Whisk with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, chili, lemon juice and 6 g salt; coat chaap and marinate 20 minutes.
Heat mustard oil until shimmering and lower the heat. Sauté onions for 5 minutes until lightly golden.
Add the marinated chaap and all yogurt mixture. Cook over medium heat for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until the yogurt thickens and clings to the pieces.
Add remaining salt to taste and cook 2 more minutes until the masala is glossy and mostly dry. Serve hot with roti and sliced onions.
tips: Crush the pickle spices only coarsely for the characteristic achari aroma; do not use sweet pickle syrup.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
